content.text:
Done. Three PNGs are in the working folder at exact sizes.

**Deliverables**
- `square.png` 1080×1080 (master), `landscape.png` 1920×1080, `story.png` 1080×1920
- `card.html` — single source file; layouts switch via aspect-ratio media queries
- `audit.js` — headless geometry checker

**Design**
- `#0F1226` ground with soft violet radial glows; white text, `#7C5CFF` accent.
- Header: logo mark + hairline divider + letterspaced "FIELDNOTES CONF 2026".
- Portrait circle-cropped (`border-radius:50%` + `object-fit:cover`, framed at `center 42%` so the face sits well), with a violet ring and a softer outer halo.
- Title set large with a violet "KEYNOTE" eyebrow; footer has date/venue split from the pill CTA by a hairline rule.
- Square stacks portrait beside name; landscape puts the speaker in a left column with the title running wide; story scales everything up for the tall frame.

**Defects found and fixed**
1. **Landscape name broke mid-surname** — "Maya Okonkwo-" / "Lindqvist". Browsers break at hyphens by default, so I wrapped the surname in a `nowrap` span (so the worst case is a clean break at the space) and widened the column to 500px, which now fits it on one line.
2. **Story felt sparse** — ~460px of dead space. Scaled avatar 300→390, title 72→80, name 54→58, with larger rhythm gaps.
3. **Landscape was under-filled** — avatar 300→340 and title 68→78, so the title holds the right column at 3 lines.

I also had to correct two false positives in my own audit: it flagged the circle as non-circular because `border-radius: 50%` reports as a percentage (needed converting against width), and it flagged text as clipped on 2–3px line-height rounding. After fixing those, the audit reports **ALL CLEAN** across all three sizes: nothing out of frame, no overlapping pairs, no clipped text, no document overflow, Inter confirmed loaded (not a fallback), and the avatar verified square with a true 50% radius. Title wraps to 3/3/4 lines; name, role, date and event name each sit on one line.
